q: 现代 ML 系统设计中，feature discussion 的重点更接近什么？
options: 手写尽可能多的 if-else 规则
识别信号来源、表示方式、新鲜度和 train/serve 一致性
options_en: Hand-write as many if-else rules as possible.
Just list thirty field names.
Identifying signal sources, representations, freshness, and train/serve parity.
Only discuss the number of model layers.
optionExplanations: 老式规则手工穷举，模型自己学不到新组合。
报字段名不等于讨论信号来源和一致性风险。
现代模型自己学交互，人要决定喂哪些信号、怎么保鲜。
层数是模型结构问题，不回答喂什么数据。
optionExplanations_en: Hand-written if-else rules are a pre-deep-learning approach the model can't extend on its own.
Naming thirty fields is not the same as discussing signal sources or consistency risk.
Modern models learn interactions themselves, but a human still decides which signals to feed and how to keep them fresh.
Layer count is a model-architecture question, not a data question.
why: 现代模型能吃文本、图像和序列，但喂哪些信号、怎么保鲜、训练服务是否一致仍由人决定。
why_en: Modern feature discussion is about choosing signal sources, representations, freshness, and train-serve parity, not hand-crafting fields.

termDefinitions.term: train/serve parity / 训练服务一致性
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时和线上服务时对同一特征算出相同的值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Train-serve parity means training and online serving compute the same value for a feature.

scenario: 面试进入数据/features 部分，你担心陷入无限 feature 列表。
q: 更好的组织方式是？
options: 按想到的顺序一直报字段
先按信号来源分桶，再每桶给代表性信号
跳过 features 直接上线
options_en: Keep listing fields in whatever order they come to mind.
Group by signal-source bucket first, then give a few representative signals per bucket.
Just say "use all the data."
Skip features entirely and go straight to launch.
optionExplanations: 想到哪说哪，容易变成无结构的字段流。
先给桶名再填代表信号，面试官能跟住结构。
没有取舍等于没有设计判断。
特征选择本身就是本轮考察重点。
optionExplanations_en: Free-associating fields turns into an unstructured stream with no natural stopping point.
Naming the buckets first lets the interviewer follow your structure before you fill in detail.
Saying 'use everything' skips the actual design decision.
Skipping features skips the exact thing this round is testing.
why: 按 content、actor、behavior、graph、context 等来源组织，面试官能跟住结构，你也能及时停止或深入。
why_en: Grouping features by signal source prevents an unstructured feature dump and makes the discussion easier to steer.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Sources[Signal sources] --> Content[Content]
  Sources --> Actor[Actor]
  Sources --> Behavior[Behavior]
  Sources --> Graph[Graph]
  Sources --> Context[Context]
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官要求某个具体字段实现，再下钻编码和服务方式。
tradeoff: 结构化分桶讲清晰 vs 穷举字段显完整

termDefinitions.term: signal source bucket / 信号来源桶
termDefinitions.meaning: 按数据的来源（内容/用户/行为/图/上下文）划分特征的分组方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A signal-source bucket groups features by where the data comes from, such as content, actor, behavior, graph, or context.

q: 文章总结的常见信号来源包括哪些？（多选，注意排除干扰项）
options_en: Content / item signals
Actor / user / author signals
Behavioral signals
Network / graph signals
Request context signals
The training batch size
optionExplanations: 这是被打分的对象本身，如帖子文本、视频。
这是参与者本身，如观看者、发帖人。
这是发生过的事，如最近点击、浏览。
这是账号/设备间的关系，如共同关注。
这是请求本身的语境，如时间、设备。
batch size 是训练超参数，不是数据信号。
optionExplanations_en: This is the item being scored itself, like a post or video.
This is the participant, like the viewer or the author.
This is what happened, like recent clicks or views.
This is the relationship between accounts or devices.
This is the context of the request itself, like time or device.
Batch size is a training hyperparameter, not a data signal.
why: 真实系统反复用这五桶信号；不同问题里各桶权重不同，但都值得先枚举再挑重点。
why_en: Common ML signal sources include item content, actors, behavior, graph relationships, and request context.

termDefinitions.meaning: 来自账号、设备间关系（如共同关注、共享 IP）的信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A graph signal comes from relationships between accounts or devices, such as shared follows or shared IPs.

scenario: 有害内容分类主要判断帖子文本和图片是否违规。
q: 最关键的信号来源通常是？
options_en: Content / item signals.
The database shard number.
The data-center room temperature.
The app's UI color scheme.
optionExplanations: 判断本质是内容本身违不违规，内容信号信息量最大。
分片号只是存储位置，和内容语义无关。
运维指标，不参与预测目标的语义判断。
前端样式，不反映帖子本身是否违规。
optionExplanations_en: The label depends on what the content itself contains, so content is the highest-signal source here.
A shard number is a storage detail, not a semantic signal.
Datacenter temperature is an ops metric with no bearing on content meaning.
UI color is a front-end style choice, unrelated to whether the post is harmful.
why: 当问题本质是“这个东西看起来是什么”，内容本身通常最高信号，应作为一等输入进模型。
why_en: When the label depends on what the item contains, content signals are usually the first-class input.
whenOtherWins: 在推荐问题中，内容常不如行为强，因为用户是否喜欢不只由视频内容决定。
tradeoff: 内容信号信息量 vs 与标签的直接相关性

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接来自被判断对象本身的信号，如文本、图片、音频。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A content signal comes directly from the item being scored, such as its text, image, or audio.

q: actor/user 信号常采用哪种生产组合？
options: 慢而丰富的长期 embedding + 快而噪的实时显式属性
options_en: Just store the user's nickname.
Don't use any user history at all.
Have a human review every single request.
A slow, rich long-term embedding plus fast, noisy real-time explicit attributes.
optionExplanations: 昵称几乎不携带行为或信誉信息。
丢弃历史等于放弃最强的个性化信号来源。
人工审核不是特征，是无法规模化的流程。
长期 embedding 稳但更新慢，实时属性补上最近异常。
optionExplanations_en: A nickname carries almost no behavioral or reputation signal.
Ignoring history throws away the strongest personalization signal.
Manual review isn't a feature — it's a process that doesn't scale.
A slow-moving embedding captures stable taste, while fast explicit attributes cover recent anomalies.
why: 长期 embedding 表达稳定偏好或信誉，实时属性表达近期异常、账号年龄、国家、举报等，两者互补。
why_en: Actor features often combine slow rich embeddings with fast explicit attributes for recent state.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Long[Long-term embedding] --> Join[Feature join]
  Fast[Real-time attributes] --> Join
  Join --> Model[Model input]
  Fast --> Alert[Recent anomaly]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把类别、用户或内容表示成模型学到的稠密向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a dense vector that a model learns to represent an entity such as a user or item.

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接记录的原始字段，如账号年龄、国家，而非学出来的向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An explicit attribute is a directly recorded field, like account age or country, rather than a learned vector.

q: 现代系统处理行为序列时，轻 ranker 和重 ranker 常有什么区别？
options: 轻 ranker 总是用视频原文件，重 ranker 只用 SQL
轻 ranker 用聚合，重 ranker 可把序列当 token 交给 Transformer
两者都只能用手写规则
轻 ranker 不需要特征
options_en: Light rankers always use raw video files, while heavy rankers only use SQL.
Light rankers use aggregates, while heavy rankers can feed the sequence as tokens into a transformer.
Both can only use hand-written rules.
Light rankers need no features at all.
optionExplanations: 视频原文件和 SQL 都不是序列的编码方式。
聚合便宜适合宽漏斗海量候选，完整序列适合候选变少后的重模型。
现代重 ranker 常用 self-attention 直接学时序，不靠手写规则。
轻 ranker 仍需要聚合特征，只是比重模型便宜。
optionExplanations_en: Raw video files and SQL are not sequence-encoding techniques at all.
Cheap aggregates fit the wide funnel's huge candidate set, while full sequences suit the narrow funnel's heavier model.
Modern heavy rankers learn temporal structure via self-attention, not hand-written rules.
Light rankers still need aggregated features, just cheaper ones.
why: 均值/时间衰减聚合便宜，适合宽漏斗；完整序列能学顺序和上下文，适合窄漏斗重模型。
why_en: Light rankers often use cheap aggregates, while heavy rankers can process event sequences directly with attention.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Seq[Event sequence] --> Agg[Mean or decay aggregate]
  Seq --> Tok[Sequence as tokens]
  Agg --> Light[Light ranker]
  Tok --> Heavy[Heavy ranker]
tradeoff: 聚合的低成本吞吐 vs 完整序列的时序表达力

termDefinitions.meaning: 让序列里每个元素都能关注其他元素来学习依赖关系的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Self-attention lets every element in a sequence attend to every other element to learn dependencies.

termDefinitions.meaning: 推荐流程里候选数量很大、需要低成本处理的早期阶段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The wide funnel is the early recommendation stage with a huge candidate set that needs cheap processing.

scenario: Bot detection 要识别协调账号、共享设备、关注关系异常。
q: 哪个信号桶最关键？
options_en: Only look at post length.
Only look at the browser color theme.
Network / graph signals.
Only look at the training batch size.
optionExplanations: 字数和是否协同作案没有因果关系。
界面偏好设置，与账号关系无关。
协调账号靠关系图和共享设备最容易暴露，比内容更难伪装。
batch size 是训练超参数，不是输入信号。
optionExplanations_en: Post length has no causal link to coordinated behavior.
Browser theme is a UI preference unrelated to account relationships.
Coordinated accounts show up in the relationship graph and shared devices, which are much harder to fake than content.
Batch size is a training hyperparameter, not an input signal.
why: 协调攻击和 botnet 往往在关系图、共享基础设施和相似活动中暴露。图信号比可伪装的内容更稳健。
why_en: Graph signals are critical for coordinated abuse because relationships and shared infrastructure are harder to fake than content.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务是单张商品图分类，图信号通常很少，内容信号会赢。
tradeoff: 图信号抗伪造 vs 内容信号采集成本低

termDefinitions.meaning: 来自账号、设备间关系（如共同关注、共享 IP）的信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A graph signal comes from relationships between accounts or devices, such as shared follows or shared IPs.

q: 请求上下文信号的特点是什么？
options: 便宜、实时，能解释当前请求的特殊性
options_en: Cheap and real-time, explaining what is special about the current request.
It can only be computed offline once a month.
It is always stronger than content signals.
It cannot be fed into the model.
optionExplanations: 时间、设备、位置几乎零成本获取，还原了这次请求的语境。
上下文特征恰恰相反，通常是请求时实时算出。
强弱取决于问题，上下文通常是补充信号而非主力。
上下文特征是最容易接入模型的一类输入。
optionExplanations_en: Time, device, and location are nearly free to compute and capture what is unique about this specific request.
Context features are the opposite — they are usually computed live at request time.
Strength depends on the problem; context is usually a supporting signal, not the main one.
Context features are among the easiest inputs to feed into a model.
why: 时间、设备、页面、当前位置或最近 query 往往容易获得且对当次意图有帮助。候选人常忘记这类信号。
why_en: Request context features are cheap real-time signals that explain what is special about the current request.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Req[Request] --> Time[Time of day]
  Req --> Device[Device type]
  Req --> Loc[Location]
  Time --> Model[Model input]
  Device --> Model
  Loc --> Model

termDefinitions.meaning: 必须等请求真正发生才能算出的特征，如当前设备。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A request-time feature can only be computed once the request actually happens, like the current device.

scenario: 同一个创作者既有“内容 embedding”又有“最近一小时举报率”两个特征。
q: 同一信号桶里的特征为什么仍要按更新频率区分？
options: 静态、批量、流式、请求时特征的服务成本差异很大
options_en: Every feature must be real-time.
Update frequency has no effect on architecture.
The slower a feature updates, the more accurate it is.
Static, batch, streaming, and request-time features have very different serving costs.
optionExplanations: 多数特征不需要实时，强上实时是浪费。
更新频率直接决定要不要建流式管线。
慢不等于准，只是反映数据本身变化的速度。
越靠近请求时刻计算，基础设施成本越高。
optionExplanations_en: Most features don't need to be real-time; forcing it wastes infrastructure.
Update frequency directly decides whether you need a streaming pipeline.
Slower isn't more accurate — it just reflects how fast the underlying data changes.
The closer to request time a feature is computed, the more infrastructure it costs.
why: 作者内容 embedding 可能每日刷新，最近一小时举报率需要流式聚合。越接近请求时计算，基础设施成本越高。
why_en: Feature freshness matters because static, batch, streaming, and request-time features have very different serving costs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过实时事件流持续聚合更新的特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A streaming feature is continuously updated by aggregating a real-time event stream.

scenario: 你提出“最近 5 分钟举报率”作为审核特征。
q: 高级候选人下一句应该补什么？
options: 确认是否值得建设流式聚合与低延迟特征服务
把它放进离线 CSV 就行
options_en: Assume it is free and available in real time.
Whether it is worth building a streaming aggregation and low-latency feature service.
Just dump it into an offline CSV.
Delete all historical features.
optionExplanations: 实时聚合从不是免费的，需要专门基础设施。
快变特征有用，但要主动权衡它值不值流式管线的成本。
5 分钟窗口放进日级离线管道就失去了时效性。
这里的问题是要不要建新管线，不是删旧特征。
optionExplanations_en: Real-time aggregation is never free — it needs dedicated infrastructure.
A fast-moving signal can help, but you should explicitly weigh whether it is worth a streaming pipeline.
A five-minute window loses its whole point inside a daily offline pipeline.
The question is whether to build a new pipeline, not whether to delete old features.
why: 快变特征有预测力但也有工程成本。面试里要说明为何它值这个成本，并如何保证训练/服务一致。
why_en: A fast-moving feature should trigger a discussion about whether a streaming pipeline is worth its cost.
whenOtherWins: 如果同等效果可由日级聚合得到，批处理特征会更简单稳健。
tradeoff: 快变信号的预测力 vs 流式管线的工程成本

termDefinitions.meaning: 持续处理实时事件、低延迟产出特征值的系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A streaming pipeline continuously processes real-time events to produce low-latency feature values.

q: 现代系统处理原始文本/图片的默认方式是什么？
options: 手工写二十个关键词计数和颜色直方图
全部转成 one-hot 用户 ID
文本 token 化进 encoder，图片 patch 化进视觉 backbone
options_en: Hand-write twenty keyword counts and color histograms.
Convert everything into one-hot user IDs.
Tokenize text into an encoder, and patch-encode images into a vision backbone.
Keep only the file size.
optionExplanations: n-gram 计数和颜色直方图是深度学习前的老式做法。
one-hot 用于稀疏类别，不是文本或图片的编码方式。
让 encoder 直接学语义，不用手工穷举计数规则。
文件大小完全丢失了内容本身的语义信息。
optionExplanations_en: Keyword counts and color histograms are the pre-deep-learning way of doing this.
One-hot encoding is for sparse categories, not for representing text or images.
Modern systems let an encoder learn semantics directly instead of hand-counting features.
File size throws away all of the content's actual semantic information.
why: 大模型能从原始内容学语义和跨模态关系，手工 n-gram/颜色特征通常只是老式 baseline。关键是把原始内容正确暴露给模型。
why_en: Modern systems usually feed raw text and images through learned encoders instead of relying on many handcrafted counts.
tradeoff: 学习式编码器的语义表达力 vs 手工特征的可解释性

termDefinitions.meaning: 把文本切成模型能处理的最小单元（token）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tokenizing splits text into the small units, called tokens, that a model can process.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个类别一个只有一位为 1 的高维稀疏向量，类别间没有相似度信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: One-hot encoding gives each category a sparse vector with a single 1, so it carries no similarity information between categories.

termDefinitions.term: vision backbone / 视觉骨干网络
termDefinitions.meaning: 负责从图片像素中提取特征的编码器，如 ViT。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A vision backbone is the encoder that extracts features from image pixels, such as a ViT.

scenario: 商品搜索要同时理解商品图片、标题和 query。
q: 更现代的表示方式是？
options: CLIP 风格对比学习，把图文和 query 对齐到共享空间
options_en: CLIP-style contrastive learning that aligns images, text, and queries into a shared space.
Match by image filename only.
Sort by price only.
Use only the query length.
optionExplanations: 对比学习让图片、文本、query 落进同一个向量空间可互相检索。
文件名是人工命名，和图片实际内容无关。
价格不表达图文语义是否匹配。
query 长度不携带语义信息。
optionExplanations_en: Contrastive training pulls images, text, and queries into one shared space so they can be matched or retrieved.
A filename is arbitrary and unrelated to what the image actually shows.
Price says nothing about whether the image and text semantically match.
Query length carries no semantic information at all.
why: 图文共同决定语义匹配，共享 embedding 空间能让图片、文本和 query 互相检索或作为 ranker 特征。
why_en: A CLIP-style shared embedding space is a modern way to align images, text, and queries.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有结构化库存和精确筛选需求，传统属性过滤可能更简单有效。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Image[Image] --> ImgEnc[Image encoder]
  Text[Title or query] --> TxtEnc[Text encoder]
  ImgEnc --> Space[Shared space]
  TxtEnc --> Space
  Space --> Match[Match or retrieve]
tradeoff: 跨模态语义对齐 vs 结构化属性过滤的简单性

termDefinitions.term: CLIP-style contrastive learning / CLIP 式对比学习
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练图文对，使匹配的图文向量更接近、不匹配的更远。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CLIP-style contrastive learning trains on image-text pairs so matching pairs land close together in the embedding space and mismatched pairs land far apart.

termDefinitions.term: shared embedding space / 共享向量空间
termDefinitions.meaning: 不同模态（图片、文本）的向量落在同一个可比较的空间里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shared embedding space is where vectors from different modalities, like images and text, can be directly compared.

q: 稀疏类别特征（user_id、item_id、枚举）常用什么表示？
options: 标准化成均值 0 方差 1 的浮点
embedding table 按 ID 查向量
options_en: Standardize it to zero mean, unit variance.
Convert it into an image.
Drop it entirely.
An embedding table looked up by ID.
optionExplanations: 标准化是数值特征的处理方式，类别 ID 没有大小意义。
把 ID 转成图片没有任何表示学习的意义。
丢弃 ID 会丢失全部个性化和物品身份信息。
类别 ID 没有数值大小关系，embedding table 让模型学出每个类别的向量。
optionExplanations_en: Standardization is for numeric features; category IDs have no magnitude to standardize.
Turning an ID into an image has no meaningful representation-learning purpose.
Dropping the ID throws away all personalization and item-identity signal.
Category IDs have no numeric ordering, so an embedding table lets the model learn a vector per category.
why: 类别 ID 没有自然数值大小，embedding table 让模型学习每个类别的低维表示。高基数时要考虑参数规模。
why_en: Sparse categorical features are commonly represented by learned embedding-table lookups.

termDefinitions.term: sparse categorical / 稀疏类别特征
termDefinitions.meaning: 取值是离散类别（如用户 ID）而非连续数值的特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sparse categorical feature takes discrete category values, like a user ID, instead of a continuous number.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按类别 ID 查表得到该类别可学习向量的结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding table is a lookup structure that returns a learned vector for a given category ID.

scenario: user_id embedding 表设 1B 行、64 维、float32，参数量约 256GB（还没算优化器状态）。
q: 这个参数量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 可以直接上线不用再优化
长尾用户不该分配和头部用户一样大的独立 embedding
说明模型精度还不够，要继续加维度
说明应该完全放弃用户 embedding
options_en: It can ship as-is with no further optimization.
Long-tail users should not get the same full-size independent embedding as heavy users.
It means the model lacks capacity, so add more dimensions.
It means user embeddings should be abandoned entirely.
why: 1B×64×4 bytes≈256GB，参数几乎都花在只出现过几次的长尾用户身上，付全价不划算。
why_en: A one-billion-row, sixty-four-dimensional float32 embedding table is about 256 gigabytes, and most of it pays for long-tail users who barely showed up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按类别 ID 查表得到该类别可学习向量的结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding table is a lookup structure that returns a learned vector for a given category ID.

scenario: 高基数 user_id 太多，完整 embedding 表参数爆炸，大量长尾用户只有几次出现。
q: 常见折中是什么？
options: 给每个用户训练一个独立模型
hashing trick 到固定桶数后再 embedding
把 user_id 当连续数值
options_en: Train a separate model per user.
Delete all long-tail users.
Apply the hashing trick into a fixed bucket count, then embed.
Treat user_id as a continuous numeric value.
optionExplanations: 为每个用户训练模型完全不现实，成本爆炸。
删除长尾用户等于放弃给他们做个性化。
哈希进固定桶数，让多个长尾 ID 共享一行，重度用户仍主导自己的桶。
ID 大小没有数值意义，当成连续值会误导模型。
optionExplanations_en: Training a separate model per user is completely impractical at this scale.
Deleting long-tail users means giving up on personalizing for them at all.
Hashing into a fixed bucket count lets many long-tail IDs share one row, while heavy users still dominate their own bucket.
An ID's numeric value is meaningless, so treating it as continuous misleads the model.
why: 哈希桶让多个 ID 共享参数，重度用户仍主导自己的桶，长尾用户退化到接近平均表示。它用少量碰撞换大幅省参数。
why_en: The hashing trick maps many IDs into a fixed number of embedding buckets, trading collisions for a much smaller table.
whenOtherWins: 如果 ID 数量不大且每个实体都有充足数据，完整 embedding 表质量更好。
tradeoff: 参数量大幅缩小 vs 少量 ID 哈希碰撞

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大量 ID 哈希进固定数量的桶，多个 ID 共享一个 embedding 行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The hashing trick maps many IDs into a fixed number of buckets so multiple IDs share one embedding row.

q: 行为序列用均值聚合的主要代价是什么？
options: 丢失顺序、间隔和会话结构
options_en: It loses order, timing, and session structure.
It fails to reduce cost.
It is always more accurate than a Transformer.
It cannot be used in a light ranker.
optionExplanations: 取均值只留下整体趋势，谁先谁后、间隔多久全部丢掉。
均值聚合恰恰是最便宜的做法，说反了。
聚合更便宜但通常信息更少，不会比完整序列准。
均值聚合正是轻 ranker 最常用的表示方式。
optionExplanations_en: Averaging keeps only the overall trend and throws away order, timing, and session boundaries.
Mean aggregation is actually the cheapest option — this has it backwards.
Aggregation is cheaper but carries less information, not more accuracy than a full sequence.
Mean aggregation is exactly the go-to representation for light rankers.
why: 平均最近观看 embedding 便宜，但不知道先后顺序和时间间隔。完整序列模型能捕捉短期意图和模式转折。
why_en: Mean aggregation of event embeddings is cheap but loses order, timing, and session structure.
tradeoff: 聚合的低成本 vs 完整序列保留的时序信息

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次连续使用中事件的先后顺序和分组关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Session structure is the order and grouping of events within one continuous usage session.

scenario: 召回后的轻 ranker 要在 CPU 上快速处理百万候选。
q: 最近观看历史如何表示更合适？
options: 把历史视频原文件全部加载
最近若干视频 embedding 的均值或时间衰减聚合
options_en: A full 16k-event Transformer.
Manually review every candidate.
Load all the raw historical video files.
A mean or recency-weighted aggregate of the most recent video embeddings.
optionExplanations: 16k 事件 Transformer 对每候选算力太贵，撑不住百万级吞吐。
人工检查根本无法达到毫秒级、百万候选的吞吐。
加载视频原文件是巨大的 I/O 开销，不是特征表示。
百万候选要求吞吐优先，聚合便宜够用。
optionExplanations_en: A 16k-event transformer per candidate is far too expensive for million-scale throughput.
Manual review can't come close to millisecond, million-candidate throughput.
Loading raw video files is a huge I/O cost, not a feature representation.
Millions of candidates demand throughput first, and cheap aggregates are good enough here.
why: 宽漏斗阶段吞吐优先，便宜聚合能给出足够信号。完整序列适合候选数变少后的重 ranker。
why_en: A wide-funnel lightweight ranker should use cheap recency-weighted aggregates rather than a full sequence Transformer.
whenOtherWins: 当候选已缩小到百级、质量更重要时，完整序列模型会更有价值。
tradeoff: 宽漏斗吞吐优先 vs 窄漏斗表达力优先

termDefinitions.term: recency-weighted aggregation / 时间衰减聚合
termDefinitions.meaning: 给较近的事件更高权重后再取聚合统计量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recency-weighted aggregation gives more recent events higher weight before combining them into a summary statistic.

q: 对 views、followers、金额这类 power-law 数值，默认变换是什么？
options_en: Use the raw value with no transform.
Log-scaling.
Convert it into a random string.
Multiply it by the user ID.
optionExplanations: 原值下 100 万浏览量的样本会完全压过其他信号。
取对数压缩幂律分布里少数极端值的影响。
转成字符串丢掉了数值本身的顺序信息。
和用户 ID 相乘没有任何统计学意义。
optionExplanations_en: Left raw, a million-view sample would swamp every other signal in training.
Log-scaling compresses the range so a handful of extreme values do not dominate training.
Turning it into a string throws away the value's numeric ordering.
Multiplying by a user ID has no statistical meaning whatsoever.
why: 幂律数值跨度巨大，原值会让少数超大样本支配模型。log 变换压缩尺度，让模型更稳。
why_en: Power-law numeric features are often log-scaled so a few huge values do not dominate the model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 少数值极大、大多数值很小的分布，如浏览量、粉丝数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A power-law distribution has a few very large values and many small ones, like view counts or follower counts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对数值取对数以压缩其数值范围。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Log-scaling applies a logarithm to a numeric value to compress its range.

scenario: 某数值与标签关系明显非单调，例如年龄段中间最高、两端较低。
q: 比简单标准化更合适的表示是？
options: 当作文本 token 拼接
options_en: Force a linear standardization.
Keep only the maximum value.
Bucket the value, then embed each bucket.
Treat it as a text token to concatenate.
optionExplanations: 标准化假设近似线性关系，这里关系明显非单调。
只留最大值丢掉了绝大部分分布信息。
分桶把区间当类别学 embedding，能学非线性、非单调效果。
数值不是语言单元，当 token 拼接没有语义基础。
optionExplanations_en: Standardization assumes a roughly linear relationship, but this one is clearly non-monotonic.
Keeping only the max value discards nearly all of the distribution's information.
Bucketing treats each range as a category and lets the model learn a non-monotonic effect.
A number isn't a language unit, so treating it as a token has no semantic basis.
why: 分桶 embedding 让模型学习每个区间的非线性效果，不强迫单调关系。桶数通常要在表达力和稀疏性之间折中。
why_en: Bucketed embeddings suit numeric features whose relationship to the label is non-monotonic.
whenOtherWins: 如果关系近似线性且模型是线性/神经网络，标准化连续值更简单。
tradeoff: 分桶捕捉非单调关系 vs 标准化的简单线性假设

termDefinitions.meaning: 把连续数值切成若干区间，每个区间当作一个类别处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bucketing discretizes a continuous value into a fixed number of ranges, each treated as its own category.

q: 数值标准化的参数应该从哪里来，并如何使用？
options: 从训练数据估计，并在 serving 时完全相同地应用
从测试数据估计，线上随意变化
每个请求重新估计全局均值
options_en: Estimate them on training data, then apply them identically at serving time.
Estimate them on test data and let them vary online.
Recompute the global mean for every request.
There is no need to record them.
optionExplanations: 参数来自训练集且线上原样复用，才能避免 train/serve skew。
用测试数据估计参数会泄漏测试信息、且线上不稳定。
每次请求重算全局均值代价极高且结果会漂移。
不记录参数，线上和训练必然对不上。
optionExplanations_en: Estimating parameters on training data and reapplying them identically online avoids train-serve skew.
Estimating on test data leaks test information and makes serving unstable.
Recomputing a global mean per request is expensive and drifts request to request.
Without recording the parameters, online and offline are guaranteed to diverge.
why: 训练/服务标准化不一致会造成 skew。均值、方差、分位点等变换参数必须版本化并在线复用。
why_en: Normalization parameters should be estimated on training data and applied identically at serving time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数值变换成均值 0、方差 1 的形式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Standardization rescales a numeric feature to zero mean and unit variance.

termDefinitions.term: train/serve skew / 训练服务偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练和线上服务对同一特征算出不同的值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Train-serve skew is when training and online serving compute different values for the same feature.

q: 直接用 negatives/views 这类小分母比例有什么风险？
options: 少量曝光会产生极不稳定的极端比例
options_en: A ratio is always worse than a raw count.
It cannot be fed into the model.
It automatically removes noise.
A tiny number of impressions produces wildly unstable extreme rates.
optionExplanations: 比例本身没问题，问题是分母太小时不稳定。
比例特征完全可以进模型，只是要先平滑。
小分母比例不会自动变干净，反而更极端。
8 次曝光 4 次负反馈就是 50%，但证据量太小，不该被信任。
optionExplanations_en: Ratios are not inherently bad — the problem is instability when the denominator is tiny.
Rate features can absolutely go into the model — they just need smoothing first.
A tiny-denominator rate does not clean itself up — it tends to swing to extremes.
Eight impressions with four negatives is a fifty percent rate, but there is far too little evidence to trust it.
why: 8 次曝光 4 个负反馈看似 50%，但证据很少。小分母比例需要平滑到先验，避免过度自信。
why_en: Raw rates with tiny denominators are unstable and should be smoothed toward a prior.

termDefinitions.meaning: 比例计算里的总次数，如总曝光数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The denominator is the total count in a ratio, such as total impressions.

scenario: 你要把负反馈率作为推荐或审核特征，但很多内容曝光很少。
q: 这段公式最适合解决什么？
options: 用先验和伪计数平滑小分母比例
options_en: Computing an exact user ID.
Smoothing a small-denominator rate using a prior and a pseudo-count.
Tokenizing text.
Training a graph neural network.
optionExplanations: 计算用户 ID 和平滑比例是完全不同的操作。
alpha 是先验率，C 控制多少真实样本能压过先验，收缩小分母比例。
分词处理文本，不处理数值比例的稳定性。
GNN 学的是图结构表示，不是分母平滑。
optionExplanations_en: Computing a user ID has nothing to do with smoothing a rate.
Alpha is the prior rate, and C is a pseudo-count controlling how many real samples it takes to overcome that prior.
Tokenization processes text, not the stability of a numeric rate.
A GNN learns graph-structure representations, not denominator smoothing.
why: alpha 是先验率，C 控制多少真实样本能压过先验。它能让低曝光内容别因偶然几个反馈被误判。
why_en: Bayesian smoothing stabilizes low-denominator rates by shrinking them toward a prior.
whenOtherWins: 如果曝光量已经巨大，原始比例和平滑比例会接近，简单比例也足够。
tradeoff: 先验收缩带来稳定性 vs 观测样本充足时的偏差

termDefinitions.meaning: 平滑公式里代表先验强度的虚拟样本数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A pseudo-count is the virtual sample size that represents how strong the prior is in a smoothing formula.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把小样本比例向一个先验值收缩的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bayesian smoothing shrinks a small-sample rate toward a prior value.

q: 指数衰减特征 exp(-Δt/τ) 中 τ 表示什么？
options: 事件影响衰减的时间尺度/半衰期含义
options_en: The total number of users.
The embedding dimensionality.
The time scale, or half-life, over which an event's influence decays.
The training batch size.
optionExplanations: τ 是时间参数，和用户规模无关。
维度是向量长度，和衰减速度是两回事。
τ 越小旧事件失效越快，τ 越大记忆越长。
batch size 是训练超参数，不是衰减系数。
optionExplanations_en: τ is a time constant, unrelated to how many users there are.
Dimensionality is vector length, a completely different concept from decay speed.
A smaller τ makes old events fade faster, while a larger τ keeps their influence longer.
Batch size is a training hyperparameter, not a decay coefficient.
why: τ 越小，旧事件越快失效；快变点击可用短 τ，长期偏好可用长 τ。它比硬切窗口更平滑。
why_en: The decay time constant controls how quickly older events lose influence.

termDefinitions.meaning: 事件权重随时间按指数规律降低的加权方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exponential decay weights an event so its influence shrinks exponentially as time passes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 权重衰减到一半所需要的时间尺度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The half-life is the time scale over which a weight decays to half its original value.

q: 为什么常同时计算 1h、1d、7d 等多个时间窗口？（多选）
options: 区分当前会话与稳定偏好
options_en: To capture short-term anomalies.
To preserve medium- and long-term trends.
To distinguish the current session from stable long-term preference.
To turn every feature static.
optionExplanations: 1 小时窗口能立刻看到异常尖峰。
7 天窗口平滑掉噪声，反映稳定趋势。
同时看短窗口和长窗口能分清是临时激增还是长期变化。
多窗口恰恰是为了捕捉变化，不是让特征变静态。
optionExplanations_en: A one-hour window immediately reveals a spike.
A seven-day window smooths out noise and reflects a stable trend.
Comparing short and long windows tells you whether this is a temporary spike or a lasting shift.
Multiple windows exist to capture change, not to make features static.
why: 短、中、长窗口共同描述“现在是否异常”以及“长期是否稳定”。过多窗口会增加成本且边际收益下降。
why_en: Multiple time windows capture short-term anomalies, medium-term trends, and stable long-term preferences.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统计某个信号时截取的一段时间范围，如最近 1 小时。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A time window is the span of time over which a signal is aggregated, such as the last hour.

scenario: 训练一个“用户看到推荐后是否点击”的模型。有人把“曝光后 24 小时内是否点击过该 item”作为训练特征加入，但线上请求发出时，这个未来点击结果还不知道。
q: 为什么这是 feature leakage，而不只是一个强特征？
options: 训练特征包含预测时还不可用的信息
options_en: The training feature contains information not yet available at prediction time.
The model has too few parameters.
The feature name is too short.
The database has no index.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Future[Future info] --> Train[Training row]
  Train --> Great[Great offline score]
  Great --> Deploy[Deploy]
  Deploy --> Fail[Online drop]
optionMeanings: 时间穿越：训练特征包含预测时不可用的信息。
命名问题：字段名不清晰。
存储/查询问题：数据库没有优化访问。
optionScenarioImpacts: 离线 AUC/准确率虚高，线上因为拿不到未来点击而崩。
可能欠拟合，但不会导致“训练偷看答案”。
最多影响可维护性，不会解释指标虚高。
可能影响特征服务延迟，但不是 leakage。
optionDirectness: 最直接，因为它用预测时刻可用性定义了 leakage。
不直接，因为它是模型能力问题。
不直接，因为它是工程可读性问题。
不直接，因为它是系统性能问题。
optionMeanings_en: Time travel: the feature contains information unavailable at prediction time.
Under-capacity: the model is too small.
Naming issue: the field name is unclear.
Storage/query issue: the database access path is not optimized.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Offline metrics look inflated, but online serving cannot use the future click.
It may underfit, but it does not mean training saw the answer.
It may hurt maintainability, but it does not explain inflated metrics.
It may affect feature serving latency, but it is not leakage.
optionDirectness_en: Most direct because leakage is defined by prediction-time availability.
Not direct because it is a model capacity issue.
Not direct because it is a readability issue.
Not direct because it is a system performance issue.
why: Feature leakage 的核心检查是：预测时刻能不能知道这个特征。这里把未来点击混进了训练行，离线指标会好看，线上会失效。
why_en: Feature leakage occurs when training uses information unavailable at prediction time; it can inflate offline metrics and fail online.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练数据使用了预测时不可能知道的信息，使离线效果虚高、上线失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training uses information that would be unavailable at prediction time, inflating offline results and failing online.

scenario: 预测视频是否会被点击，却使用 total_clicks_lifetime 包含这次曝光之后的点击。
q: 这是什么问题？
options_en: Regularization.
Cold start.
Quantization.
Temporal leakage.
optionExplanations: 正则化是防止过拟合的技术，和特征时间无关。
冷启动是缺历史，这里恰恰是历史包含了太多（未来）。
量化是压缩模型精度的技术，与本题无关。
统计量包含了曝光之后才发生的点击，属于时间泄漏。
optionExplanations_en: Regularization prevents overfitting; it has nothing to do with feature timing.
Cold start is about missing history — here the problem is history containing too much, from the future.
Quantization compresses model precision — unrelated to this issue.
The statistic includes clicks that happened after the impression, which is temporal leakage.
why: 训练行看到了未来点击，模型离线会虚高。应该使用截至曝光前的历史统计或严格按时间构造特征。
why_en: Using lifetime clicks that include future events is temporal leakage.
whenOtherWins: 如果该特征只在离线报表中解释历史表现而不用于预测，泄漏风险不影响线上模型。
tradeoff: 使用全量历史统计 vs 只用曝光前历史（避免泄漏）

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征统计不小心包含了预测时刻之后才发生的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Temporal leakage is when a feature's statistic accidentally includes data from after the prediction moment.

q: 冷启动特征缺失时，比简单填平均值更清晰的做法是什么？
options: 把缺失当作 0 且不说明
用 missing sentinel 或冷启动专用特征/模型，让模型学习缺失含义
假设新实体和热门实体一样
options_en: Silently fill missing values with 0.
Use a missing sentinel or a cold-start-specific feature set so the model learns what absence means.
Delete all new users.
Assume new entities behave like popular ones.
optionExplanations: 填 0 会让模型误以为这是一个真实的低值。
显式标记缺失，模型能学会区分“真的是 0”和“未知”。
删除新用户等于放弃产品最需要保护的一批人。
假设新实体和热门实体一样会让冷启动预测严重失真。
optionExplanations_en: Silently filling zero makes the model think it is a real low value, not an unknown.
An explicit missing sentinel lets the model learn the difference between a true zero and an unknown value.
Deleting new users abandons exactly the cohort the product most needs to nurture.
Assuming new entities behave like popular ones badly distorts cold-start predictions.
why: 平均值可能假装“我们知道”，而 missing sentinel 明确告诉模型“未知”。训练集中也必须包含缺失案例。
why_en: A missing sentinel or cold-start-specific feature set lets the model learn what absence of history means.

termDefinitions.meaning: 显式表示某特征当前未知，而不是悄悄填一个默认值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A missing sentinel explicitly flags that a feature's value is unknown instead of silently defaulting it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户或新物品缺少历史数据，常规特征无法计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is when a new user or item lacks history, so the usual features can't be computed.

scenario: 新用户没有 7d_watch_count，但平台必须立刻推荐内容。
q: 特征层合理方案是？
options: 把 7d_watch_count 填成超级用户数
用 onboarding/context/content 相似人群，并显式标记历史缺失
options_en: Fill 7d_watch_count with a power-user value.
Refuse to serve new users.
Use onboarding, context, and content-similarity signals, and explicitly flag the missing history.
Rely only on the database auto-increment ID.
optionExplanations: 把新用户伪装成超级用户会严重误导排序。
拒绝新用户直接毁掉冷启动体验和留存。
用能立即拿到的信号，并明确告诉模型历史是缺的。
自增 ID 只是顺序号，不携带任何行为信息。
optionExplanations_en: Disguising a new user as a power user badly misleads ranking.
Refusing to serve new users destroys onboarding experience and retention.
Use signals that are available immediately and explicitly tell the model that history is missing.
An auto-increment ID is just a sequence number with zero behavioral signal.
why: 冷启动应使用能立即获得的信号，并告诉模型历史缺失。随着行为积累再切换到完整特征。
why_en: Cold-start users should be served with immediately available context and explicit missing-history indicators.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品可以等待足够行为再个性化，短期用非个性化热门列表会更简单。
tradeoff: 冷启动专用特征保护体验 vs 个性化精度暂时较弱

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户或新物品缺少历史数据，常规特征无法计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is when a new user or item lacks history, so the usual features can't be computed.

scenario: 推荐模型用“近期高曝光”作为特征，又持续给高曝光视频更多展示。
q: 主要风险是什么？
options_en: A rich-get-richer feedback loop.
L2 regularization is too strong.
The image encoder is too small.
The feature cannot be cached.
optionExplanations: 特征不再只反映内容受欢迎，还反映了模型自己推过它。
正则强度是训练超参数，不解释自我强化现象。
encoder 容量和曝光反馈循环是两个不相关的问题。
能不能缓存是工程问题，不是这里的核心风险。
optionExplanations_en: The feature no longer just reflects popularity — it also reflects that the model already promoted it.
Regularization strength is a training hyperparameter, not the cause of self-reinforcement.
Encoder capacity and the exposure feedback loop are unrelated issues.
Cacheability is an engineering detail, not the core risk here.
why: 模型曝光会反过来制造未来曝光特征，特征不再只表示内容受欢迎，而表示模型过去推过它。需要探索流量或 propensity 修正。
why_en: Exposure features can create rich-get-richer feedback loops because recommendations generate the future feature values.
whenOtherWins: 如果曝光来自外部随机渠道而非模型决策，反馈循环会弱一些。
tradeoff: 利用曝光信号提升排序 vs 曝光本身被模型污染

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型的推荐结果又反过来生成未来训练用的特征，形成自我强化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feedback loop is when the model's own recommendations generate the future feature values used to retrain it, reinforcing itself.

scenario: 对抗场景中，一个内容关键词规则今天 80% 准，半年后被绕过变 30% 准。
q: 更稳健的特征方向是什么？
options: 时间、网络、设备等更难伪造的行为/图信号
options_en: More public keyword regex rules.
Only use the user's nickname.
Only look at post length.
Harder-to-fake behavioral and graph signals like timing, network, and device.
optionExplanations: 关键词规则正是最容易被绕过的一类特征。
昵称可以随意改，几乎没有鲁棒性。
长度很容易伪装，鲁棒性同样很差。
攻击者能快速改内容，但很难长期伪造自然的时间节奏和关系图。
optionExplanations_en: Keyword rules are exactly the kind of feature adversaries route around fastest.
A nickname can be changed at will and carries almost no robustness.
Length is trivial to fake, so it is just as fragile.
Attackers can rewrite content quickly, but faking natural timing and network patterns over time is much harder.
why: 攻击者最容易改可见内容，较难长期伪造自然节奏、关系图和跨设备模式。特征要评估鲁棒性而不只是当前准确率。
why_en: Adversarial systems should favor robust temporal and network signals over easily adapted content rules.
whenOtherWins: 在非对抗、规则稳定的合规场景，简单规则可能足够且可解释。
tradeoff: 长期鲁棒性 vs 当前准确率

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征在攻击者主动适应后依然有效的程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adversarial robustness is how well a feature keeps working after an attacker actively adapts to it.

q: feature drift 指什么？
options: 生产特征分布随时间变化，和训练分布不再一致
训练 loss 一定降低
options_en: The model automatically shrinks.
Production feature distributions change over time and no longer match the training distribution.
Training loss always goes down.
All labels turn positive.
optionExplanations: drift 描述数据分布变化，不影响模型参数量。
节假日、新品类、单位变化都会让线上分布偏离训练时的分布。
drift 通常让线上表现变差，不是让 loss 降低。
drift 是特征分布问题，和标签是否为正例无关。
optionExplanations_en: Drift describes a change in data distribution, not a shrinking model.
Holidays, new categories, or a unit change can all shift the production distribution away from training.
Drift usually hurts online performance, not lowers training loss.
Drift is about feature distributions, unrelated to whether labels turn positive.
why: 节假日、新品类、日志单位变化都可能让特征分布漂移。要监控覆盖率、均值、分位数和类别频率。
why_en: Feature drift means production feature distributions change relative to training data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上特征分布随时间偏离训练时的分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feature drift is when production feature distributions shift away from what the model was trained on.

scenario: 上游日志把金额单位从美元改成美分，模型分数突然异常。
q: 特征监控应如何发现？
options: 监控数值分布和异常 guardrail，必要时丢弃/降级该特征
options_en: Only watch overall accuracy.
Restart the front end.
Monitor the value distribution with an anomaly guardrail, and drop or degrade the feature when needed.
Increase the embedding dimensionality.
optionExplanations: 整体 accuracy 变化滞后，等它掉下来问题已经很久了。
前端和特征单位错误完全无关。
监控数值分布能第一时间发现单位漂移，并自动降级坏特征。
加维度不解决输入本身已经错的问题。
optionExplanations_en: Overall accuracy reacts too slowly — by the time it drops, the problem has been live for a while.
Restarting the frontend has nothing to do with a feature unit bug.
Monitoring the value distribution catches a unit shift immediately and lets you auto-degrade the bad feature.
Adding dimensions does not fix input data that is already wrong.
why: 单位变化会让数值分布整体偏移，服务时特征异常检测能及时报警或禁用特征，避免坏输入直接进模型。
why_en: Serving-time feature distribution monitoring can catch unit changes and guardrail corrupted features.
whenOtherWins: 如果该特征不用于线上模型，只影响离线报表，降级策略可以更宽松。
tradeoff: 主动 guardrail 及时止损 vs 靠整体指标事后才发现
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Feature[Serving feature stream] --> Dist[Distribution monitor]
  Dist --> Alert[Unit shift alert]
  Alert --> Guard[Drop or degrade feature]
  Guard --> Model[Protected model]

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测到特征异常时自动丢弃或降级，避免坏输入进模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A guardrail automatically drops or degrades a feature when it looks corrupted, keeping bad input out of the model.

q: 按正确顺序组织 feature discussion。
why: 先给结构，再给代表信号，然后讲表示与生产风险。这样既有广度又不掉进字段清单。
why_en: A strong feature discussion groups sources, gives representative signals, explains representation, and calls out pitfalls.
steps: 说明每类信号如何编码和服务
指出 leakage/cold start/drift 等主要坑
每桶给少量代表性高价值信号
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Buckets[Source buckets] --> Signals[Top signals]
  Signals --> Encode[Encode and serve]
  Encode --> Pitfalls[Leakage drift cold start]

termDefinitions.meaning: 先标注一个话题稍后再回来讲，避免打断主线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: To earmark is to flag a topic for later depth without derailing the main flow.

q: 按正确顺序构造一个稳健的负反馈率特征。
why: 先定义计数和分母，再处理小样本不稳定，之后加入时间性并保证线上线下一致。缺一步都可能让特征不可靠。
why_en: A robust rate feature counts events, smooths low denominators, adds recency windows, and preserves train-serve parity.
steps: 按多个时间窗口/衰减计算近期信号
对小分母比例做 Bayesian smoothing
确保训练和 serving 使用同一计算逻辑
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Count[Count events] --> Smooth[Smooth rate]
  Smooth --> Window[Add time windows]
  Window --> Parity[Train serve parity]
  Parity --> Feature[Robust rate feature]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把小样本比例向先验值收缩的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bayesian smoothing shrinks a small-sample rate toward a prior value.

scenario: 同一个 Bayesian smoothing 公式：rate = (negative_reactions + prior*pseudo_count) / (views + pseudo_count)。
q: 当 views 远大于 pseudo_count 时，rate 会趋近于什么？
codeSample:
prior = 0.02
pseudo_count = 50
rate = (negative_reactions + prior * pseudo_count) / (views + pseudo_count)
options: 趋近于观测到的原始比例 negative_reactions/views
在 views 增大时反而变得更不稳定
options_en: It converges to the raw observed ratio, negative_reactions divided by views.
It always equals the prior.
It converges to zero, regardless of exposure.
It becomes less stable as views grows.
optionExplanations: 分母被真实观测样本主导，先验的权重被稀释到可以忽略。
只有 views 接近 0 时才接近先验，views 变大后不成立。
分子分母都随真实曝光和负反馈增长，不会趋于 0。
样本越多方差越小，估计只会更稳定，不会更不稳定。
optionExplanations_en: The denominator becomes dominated by real observations, so the prior's weight becomes negligible.
It only stays near the prior when views is close to zero — not once views grows large.
Both numerator and denominator grow with real exposure and negatives, so it does not head to zero.
More samples mean lower variance — the estimate gets more stable, not less.
why: views 越大，pseudo_count 在分母里的占比越小，先验的拉力被观测数据压过。
why_en: As views grows far past the pseudo-count, the prior's pull shrinks and the smoothed rate converges to the raw observed ratio.
whenOtherWins: 如果曝光量始终很小，平滑值会一直贴近先验而不是原始比例。
tradeoff: 先验保护低曝光估计 vs 高曝光时应完全信任观测值

termDefinitions.meaning: 当输入量（这里是曝光数）趋于很大时公式的极限表现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Asymptotic behavior describes how a formula behaves as an input, like view count, grows very large.

termDefinitions.meaning: 平滑公式里代表先验强度的虚拟样本数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A pseudo-count is the virtual sample size that represents how strong the prior is in a smoothing formula.

q: Feature discussion 里应主动提到哪些生产坑？（多选）
options_en: Leakage
Cold start
Feedback loops
Drift
optionExplanations: 泄漏让离线指标虚高、上线却拿不到那个特征。
冷启动是新用户/新物品缺历史，常规特征算不出来。
反馈循环是模型自己的曝光决定了未来训练特征。
漂移是线上特征分布偷偷偏离了训练时的分布。
optionExplanations_en: Leakage inflates offline metrics with information you will not have online.
Cold start is missing history for new users or items.
A feedback loop is the model's own exposure shaping its future training features.
Drift is production feature distributions quietly diverging from training.
why: 这些问题常让离线效果和线上结果脱节。能主动识别说明你不只是会列字段。
why_en: A production feature discussion should proactively cover leakage, cold start, feedback loops, and drift.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练数据使用了预测时不可能知道的信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training uses information that would be unavailable at prediction time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户或新物品缺少历史数据，常规特征无法计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is when a new user or item lacks history, so the usual features can't be computed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型的推荐结果又反过来生成未来训练用的特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feedback loop is when the model's own recommendations generate its future training features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上特征分布随时间偏离训练时的分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feature drift is when production feature distributions shift away from what the model was trained on.

q: train/serve skew 最常见的危害是什么？
options: 离线学到的特征分布和线上输入不一致，性能突然掉
options_en: The model cannot save files.
All requests turn into batch processing.
Labels automatically become clean.
The offline-learned feature distribution no longer matches online input, and performance suddenly drops.
optionExplanations: 文件保存是工程细节，和特征一致性无关。
skew 不会把在线请求变成批处理。
skew 是特征分布问题，不会清理标签质量。
训练看到的分布和线上算出来的不一样，模型就在陌生输入上做决策。
optionExplanations_en: File persistence is an engineering detail unrelated to feature consistency.
Skew does not turn online requests into batch processing.
Skew is a feature-distribution problem — it does not clean up label quality.
The model ends up making decisions on inputs whose distribution it never actually trained on.
why: 训练和服务若用不同代码、窗口或归一化参数，模型上线会看到没学过的输入。Feature store 或共享变换逻辑能缓解。
why_en: Train-serve skew causes the model to see different feature distributions online than it learned offline.

termDefinitions.term: train/serve skew / 训练服务偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练和线上服务对同一特征算出不同的值或分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Train-serve skew is when training and serving compute different values or distributions for the same feature.

scenario: 多个团队复用同一用户特征，离线训练和在线 serving 总出不一致。
q: 合理的基础设施方向是？
options: 每个团队各写一套 SQL
Feature store 或共享特征计算层，版本化变换逻辑
options_en: Let every team write its own SQL.
A feature store or shared computation layer with versioned transform logic.
Rely on documentation alone.
Delete all real-time features.
optionExplanations: 各写一套 SQL 正是造成不一致的根源。
共享层统一定义和版本，离线训练和在线服务读同一份逻辑。
文档约定没有强制力，代码一改文档就过时。
删掉实时特征牺牲了信号，没解决口径不一致的问题。
optionExplanations_en: Everyone writing their own SQL is exactly what causes the inconsistency.
A shared layer keeps one versioned definition that both offline training and online serving read from.
Documentation has no enforcement — it goes stale the moment the code changes.
Deleting real-time features sacrifices signal without fixing the actual inconsistency.
why: 共享特征层能统一口径、存储版本和在线离线访问路径，减少 skew。它不是银弹，但比复制 SQL 稳。
why_en: A feature store or shared computation layer helps keep offline and online feature definitions consistent.
whenOtherWins: 小型原型只有一个模型时，共享库加测试可能已足够。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Def[Feature definitions] --> Store[Feature store]
  Store --> Train[Offline training]
  Store --> Serve[Online serving]
  Train --> Model[Model]
  Serve --> Model
tradeoff: 统一口径减少 skew vs 搭建共享基础设施的前期投入

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一管理特征定义、版本和离线/在线访问路径的基础设施。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store is shared infrastructure that keeps feature definitions, versions, and offline/online access consistent.

scenario: 面试官给了大约 10 分钟做整个 feature/data 讨论，你还没讲完就已经过半。
q: 这个时间量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 应该在 10 分钟内讲完整个模型架构
应该跳过 pitfalls 只讲 encoding
必须用结构化 sketch 控制节奏，能随时停止或深入
应该按字段名字母顺序逐个讲
options_en: You should cover the entire model architecture within these ten minutes.
You should skip pitfalls and only talk about encoding.
You need a structured sketch that lets you stop or go deeper at any point.
You should go through fields in alphabetical order by name.
why: 10 分钟讲不完所有信号来源和坑，先给结构、按信号来源分桶再挑重点，才能被打断也不慌。
why_en: With only about ten minutes, a structured sketch by source bucket lets you stop or go deeper whenever the interviewer wants.

termDefinitions.term: signal source bucket / 信号来源桶
termDefinitions.meaning: 按数据的来源（内容/用户/行为/图/上下文）划分特征的分组方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A signal-source bucket groups features by where the data comes from, such as content, actor, behavior, graph, or context.

q: feature discussion 里的 earmark 技巧是什么？
options: 指出一个值得深挖的点并暂存，避免主线被拉走
只讲自己最喜欢的模型
options_en: Naming a point worth going deeper on and setting it aside, without derailing the main thread.
Pretend not to know the answer.
Erase the whiteboard content.
Only talk about your favorite model.
optionExplanations: 先点名风险、再说“稍后回来”，显示深度但不占用主线时间。
假装不知道等于放弃展示你其实想到了这一点。
删掉内容会让面试官以为你放弃了这条线索。
只挑自己熟的模型讲，忽略了面试官关心的问题本身。
optionExplanations_en: Name the risk, say you'll come back to it, and you show depth without spending time on it now.
Pretending not to know gives up the credit for having thought of it at all.
Erasing the whiteboard signals you are abandoning that thread entirely.
Only talking about your favorite model ignores what the interviewer actually asked about.
why: 例如“行为信号有 train/serve skew 风险，我先标记，评估/serving 时回来”。这样显示深度又保留时间。
why_en: Earmarking flags a topic for later depth without derailing the main interview flow.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先标注一个话题稍后再回来讲，避免打断主线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: To earmark is to flag a topic for later depth without derailing the main flow.

scenario: 有害内容系统中，帖子文本图片很强，网络信号只有协调攻击时才有用。
q: 如何表达特征优先级最好？
options: 平均讨论每个来源同样久
只讲自己熟悉的图模型
先说明高信号内容特征，再标记网络信号作为可深挖风险切片
options_en: Spend equal time discussing every source.
Only talk about the graph model you know best.
Ignore network risk entirely.
Lead with the high-signal content features, then earmark network signals as a risk slice to go deeper on.
optionExplanations: 平均分配时间会把宝贵时间花在低信号来源上。
只讲自己熟的图模型偏离了这题真正的高信号来源。
完全不提网络信号会让面试官以为你没想到协同作案风险。
先讲信号最强的内容特征，网络信号弱但有风险时用 earmark 保留。
optionExplanations_en: Splitting time evenly wastes precious minutes on low-signal sources.
Sticking to your favorite graph model drifts away from this problem's actual highest-signal source.
Never mentioning network signals suggests you missed the coordinated-abuse risk entirely.
Lead with the strongest signal, content, then earmark the weaker but risk-relevant network signal for later.
why: 特征讨论要服务问题假设，而不是机械清单。把主要信号讲清，再 earmark 次要但有风险的来源。
why_en: Feature prioritization should follow the problem hypothesis while earmarking secondary sources for relevant deep dives.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目明确是 botnet 或 fraud，网络信号可能从次要变成主信号。
tradeoff: 按信号强度排优先级 vs 面面俱到平均分配时间
